structured_output.summary: Adds an agent.intl branch to toLocaleUpperCase and toLocaleLowerCase that follows the ECMA-402 steps: RequireObjectCoercible, then ToString, then TransformCase. TransformCase canonicalizes the locale list and falls back to the default locale. It matches against a list of tags with language-sensitive case mappings, resolves to "und" when nothing matches, and maps with ICU4X CaseMapper in the resolved language. The ECMA-262 path is unchanged when agent.intl is false. Errors propagate with `?`. Lone surrogates are passed through, and they correctly end a context run. The tag list (az, el, lt, tr) is a spec-permitted Available Locales List, not a test-keyed table. The only fallback is a not-implemented error for an unparsable resolved locale, which should be unreachable. The gate report shows 18 of 18 target tests passing with no regressions.
